renderPacket.identity: Real Victoria Harbour seen from Lugard Road Lookout on The Peak in a very wide distant panorama; Victoria Harbour is the dominant open shape, with the dense Central/Hong Kong Island urban mass occupying only the lower-right quarter and Kowloon forming a smaller distant band across the water; individual skyscrapers are small and subordinate, with only broad real skyline anchors and no invented landmark towers; visible green hillside edge in the immediate lower foreground, distant mountains through restrained humid haze; calm early morning blue-gold light rather than dramatic sunset; generous quiet sky and water for Hero copy; photo 6 : quiet watercolor 4; realistic geography and city proportions, no Peak Tower foreground, no neon/night treatment.

Real Hong Kong double-deck tram moving through a north-Hong-Kong-Island street around Central/Sheung Wan; tram, rails, street canyon and natural-scale pedestrians in one urban landscape; late morning or soft late-afternoon light; advertising and shop signs incidental and unreadable; no neon/cyberpunk treatment; photo 6 : quiet watercolor 4.

Real Tai O fishing-village canal on western Lantau; stilt houses lining the waterway, small local boats at natural scale and low mountains behind; broad canal perspective in humid subtropical daylight; no Venice-like exaggeration, luxury marina or fantasy village; photo 6 : quiet watercolor 4.

Real Dragon's Back ridge in Shek O Country Park; open green rolling crest with coastal inlets/Big Wave Bay side only where geographically plausible, narrow walking trail with tiny or no people; clear autumn/winter visibility and restrained coastal haze; no alpine mountain or resort-beach styling; photo 6 : quiet watercolor 4.

Real High Island Reservoir East Dam area in Hong Kong UNESCO Global Geopark; large rhyolitic hexagonal rock columns clearly readable in a broad geological slope, reservoir/sea/dam geometry only where the real viewpoint supports it; clear or lightly clouded daylight; no Giant's-Causeway substitution or invented sea stacks; photo 6 : quiet watercolor 4.

Real Mai Po / Inner Deep Bay wetland landscape; broad mosaic of shallow ponds, mangrove/reed edges and mudflat character, one or a few migratory waterbirds only at natural scale; low horizon and soft morning light; wetland remains the subject, no safari bird portrait or skyline dominance; photo 6 : quiet watercolor 4.

Real Chi Lin Nunnery and Nan Lian Garden in Diamond Hill; calm viewpoint linking timber monastery architecture, garden, pond/pavilion and restrained real mountain/city context; modern high-rises only as plausible subordinate backdrop; soft daylight, muted gold/timber/stone/green; no Japanese-garden substitution or fantasy pagoda; photo 6 : quiet watercolor 4.

Real Lai Chi Wo Hakka village in northeastern New Territories; compact tile-roofed village fabric framed by mature feng shui woodland and low hills, slightly elevated/open-edge viewpoint that explains settlement form; spring or early-autumn natural light; no theme-park restoration or invented fortification; photo 6 : quiet watercolor 4.

Real Cheung Chau harbourfront near ferry-pier/Pak She Praya side; fishing boats and small local vessels at natural scale, low-rise waterfront town and island hills; broad late-afternoon harbour composition; no restaurant-table foreground, readable signage, luxury-yacht marina, Mediterranean styling or resort skyline; photo 6 : quiet watercolor 4.

Hong Kong har gow as one coherent serving: one small bamboo steamer only, four translucent pleated shrimp dumplings, shrimp structure visible through wrappers; centered on plain pale beige/warm ivory background; no other dim sum, tea, chopsticks, sauce, garnish or props; photo 6 : quiet watercolor 4; exact 3:2.

Hong Kong wonton noodles as one dish: one simple bowl only, thin egg noodles in clear pale-golden broth with several shrimp/pork wontons; centered on plain pale beige/warm ivory background; no chopsticks, spoon, condiments, roast meat, extra bowl or props; photo 6 : quiet watercolor 4; exact 3:2.

Hong Kong roast goose rice as one integrated dish: one simple plate only, lacquered crisp-skinned roast-goose slices dominant with a modest portion of rice; centered on plain pale beige/warm ivory background; no second meat, sauce saucer, cutlery, drink, vegetables as styling props or loose ingredients; photo 6 : quiet watercolor 4; exact 3:2.

One Hong Kong-style egg tart only, centered on one small simple plate; smooth yellow custard and flaky or shortcrust pastry clearly visible; plain pale beige/warm ivory background; no second tart, tea, napkin, bakery box, crumbs, ingredients or props; photo 6 : quiet watercolor 4; exact 3:2.
